object_description: quiet, flat triple-gabled volume facing the schoolyard, with a slender residential addition
design_condition: the new volume is set to the north facing the upgraded schoolyard as a keystone inscribed into the existing set of rules, with a slender residential building added to the south for further densification

positive: The new building is integrated into the historic complex with a very clear and convincing setting
The authors seek continuity and transition rather than contrast, finding an appropriate keystone for the complex
The slender residential addition to the south is as surprising as it is consistent, in the spirit of densification
The quiet, flat, triple-gabled volume faces the upgraded schoolyard
Existing outdoor space qualities around the historic buildings are recognised and largely retained
A loosely tree-lined meadow sets the sports hall courtyard pleasantly apart from the sports areas
The listed pavilion forms the centre of the square and logically houses the school management
The robust structure exudes a striking presence and offers maximum flexibility inside
The elevated entrance area makes a generous welcoming gesture and acts as a hub for collective uses
The building develops upwards as an ingenious sectional project, interpreting the cluster school vertically
The folded roofs are given spatial meaning
The double staircase set into the light from above works elegantly as a cross-connection between clusters
A highly flexible learning landscape is created on the upper floor
Escape balconies in front provide the fire protection framework for versatile playability
Classrooms, group rooms, meeting zones and loggias can be flexibly interconnected
The special classrooms are efficiently lined up and lit via a rear excavation
The escape balconies give a good basis for free furnishing of the interior areas
The relatively compact structure with few offsets supports the energy standard
High rooms and almost no ceiling lintel promise medium to good use of daylight
Investment costs are in the lower range thanks to convincing organisation, compact design and low intervention
The staged, vividly presented spatial dramaturgy creates added value for the entire complex
A beautiful linguistic link to the existing complex is made in a contemporary canon of concrete and wood
Impresses with situational clarity, interior richness, functional load-bearing capacity and long-term flexibility
negative: The building line at the pitches must be shifted north, slightly shortening the sports fields
The locations for the checkroom areas still need to be determined
The group rooms along the front facades do not allow views of the surroundings
It is questionable whether some WC facilities should be located in the day school area
The day school is still too schematically organised overall
The escape route concept still needs to be revised
Additional measures in insulation perimeter, daylight use and shading are needed for the energy standard
The few offsets create weaker areas in the insulation perimeter
